understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by placing all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked with '+' such that every goal tile is occupied simultaneously, and to do so within the limited step budget per level to eventually trigger WIN for the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was performed with MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN for the currently selected piece, and CLICK actions were used to select or directly reposition a selectable piece to a specified coordinate when allowed by the level rules. Walls/obstacles prevented movement into blocked tiles, causing actions to have no effect when the destination was invalid or unreachable. With multiple selectable pieces, CLICK was necessary to switch which piece was being manipulated, and success required coordinating all pieces so they ended on their respective goal tiles at the same time without running out of steps.
